test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.

His last trip around the world __taking a toll__ on his health.
solution:
The solution is **took a toll.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• It indicates that the result of his last trip had an immediate effect on his health.
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase should be '**took a toll'** which refers to the **past tense**.
 
• The use of '**took a toll**' correctly establishes the temporal relationship (**past**) and the causative impact (**toll on health**) intended in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• '**Take a toll**' or '**took a toll**' is a phrase used to indicate a negative impact or harmful effect on someone or something.
 
• In this context, it expresses that his health was negatively affected.
